system.description:
You project a phantasmal Genjutsu image of all creatures' worst fears in a target area. Each creature in a 90 Foot Cube originating from you must make a Charisma saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature drops whatever it is holding.

Failure: Affected creatures drops whatever it is holding and gains 2 ranks of Demoralized. For the duration, when a creature with ranks of Demoralized would take psychic damage, they take an additional 4d6 psychic damage.

Critical Failure: Same as Failure, but affected creatures instead take 6d6 psychic damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
